# Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025

The world of pitch competition events is set to reach new heights in 2025, attracting founders and investors from every corner of the globe. With record-breaking prizes and unparalleled opportunities for exposure, these events are transforming how startups launch and scale.

In this article, you will discover the top 10 pitch competition events to watch in 2025, each offering unique features, impressive rewards, and game-changing connections. Whether you are a founder eager for funding, an investor searching for the next big idea, or a startup enthusiast looking to stay ahead, you will find valuable insights here.

Get ready to unlock the secrets to massive funding, global networking, and startup acceleration. Dive in, explore these events, and take the first step toward your next breakthrough.

## Why Pitch Competitions Matter in 2025

Pitch competition events have become a driving force for startups, investors, and the innovation ecosystem worldwide. In 2025, their significance is bigger than ever, offering founders a global stage to showcase ideas, attract funding, and accelerate growth.

**Investment Pools Are Growing**

The scale of pitch competition prizes in 2025 is unprecedented. Many top events now feature $1 million-plus investment pools. This surge in funding attracts more ambitious founders and top-tier investors. For example, Startup World Cup and Slush both offer seven-figure prizes, making the pitch competition circuit a prime launchpad for startups seeking serious capital.

Not only are prizes bigger, but investors are increasingly using these competitions to spot high-potential ventures early. The number of startups funded through pitch competition events has grown by over 25% since 2023. Application rates have also soared, with thousands of founders vying for limited spots at elite events.

**Diversity and Accessibility Redefined**

Pitch competition events now represent a broader range of industries than ever before. Whether you build in AI, healthtech, sustainability, or fintech, there is a pitch competition tailored to your sector. Events like TechCrunch Disrupt and South Summit attract startups from dozens of verticals, reflecting the ever-expanding innovation landscape.

Hybrid and virtual formats are making pitch competition participation more accessible. In 2024, 40% more startups joined hybrid or online events compared to 2022. This shift enables founders from emerging markets to compete on equal footing, breaking down traditional barriers of geography and cost.

| Sector | % of Competitions in 2025 | Notable Events |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI & Deep Tech | 30% | Slush, TechCrunch |
| Healthtech | 20% | Startup World Cup |
| Fintech | 15% | Web Summit |
| Sustainability | 15% | South Summit |
| Other | 20% | Regional/Youth events |

**Unmatched Benefits for Startups**

Startups gain far more than funding from a pitch competition. These events deliver mentorship, media exposure, and access to investor networks that can transform a company’s trajectory. According to [Benefits of Pitch Competitions for Startup Showcases](https://fastercapital.com/articles/What-are-the-benefits-of-pitch-competitions-for-startup-showcases.html), founders receive expert feedback, visibility, and partnership opportunities that often lead to further growth.

Networking is a major draw. Founders meet potential co-founders, advisors, and customers at a pitch competition. Hybrid formats mean even remote teams can pitch to global audiences. Many competitions now offer post-event support, from accelerator placements to VC introductions, making participation a crucial step for early and growth-stage startups.

**Success Stories and Innovation Trends**

Pitch competition events have helped launch some of the world’s most successful startups. Dropbox and Trello, for instance, gained early traction and investor interest through high-profile competitions. In 2024-2025, several unicorns credit their breakthrough to exposure and connections made at a pitch competition.

These events also set the tone for entrepreneurship trends. They encourage bold ideas, foster cross-sector collaboration, and accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies. For founders, investors, and the broader ecosystem, pitch competition events in 2025 are essential engines of innovation.

## Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025

The world of pitch competition events is evolving quickly, offering founders, investors, and enthusiasts unmatched opportunities. To help you navigate the global landscape, we’ve curated a list of the top 10 pitch competition events to watch in 2025.

Our methodology prioritizes global reach, prize value, reputation, diversity of entrants, and unique value propositions. We shuffled the list for a fresh perspective, covering multiple regions and industries. Each event features key details: pricing, core features, benefits, target audience, pros, and cons.

Participating in a pitch competition can be a game changer for startups, providing funding, mentorship, and crucial exposure. For a deeper look at how these events shape business futures, check out the [Power of Pitching: How Startup Competitions Shape Business Futures](https://fastercapital.com/content/Startup-competitions--The-Power-of-Pitching--How-Startup-Competitions-Shape-Business-Futures.html).

### [Slush 2025](https://slush.org/)

Slush 2025 in Helsinki stands out as a premier international pitch competition. Early bird pricing is TBA, but pre-registration is recommended for the best access.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Slush 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4e5_1760340880952-https___slush_org_.jpeg)

- **Features:** €1,000,000 investment prize, global investors, 25,000+ attendees.
- **Benefits:** Tailored matchmaking, robust startup support, high-profile speakers.
- **Target Audience:** Tech startups, scale-ups, global founders.
- **Pros:** Massive investment pool, strong Nordic network, global exposure.
- **Cons:** High competition, travel costs, selective entry.

This pitch competition is ideal for ambitious founders seeking a global stage and significant investment opportunities.

### [Startup World Cup 2025](https://www.startupworldcup.io/)

Startup World Cup 2025 hosts over 60 regional pitch competition events, culminating in a grand finale in Silicon Valley. Pricing is not yet available.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Startup World Cup 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4e2_1760340887737-https___www_startupworldcup_io_.jpeg)

- **Features:** $1,000,000 investment prize, world-class judges, mentorship.
- **Benefits:** Global exposure, investor access, media attention.
- **Target Audience:** Startups across all industries, especially those eyeing international expansion.
- **Pros:** Largest cash prize, prestigious panel, extensive network.
- **Cons:** Intense competition, multi-stage qualification.

If your startup is ready for the global spotlight, this pitch competition is a must-consider.

### [TechCrunch Disrupt 2025](https://techcrunch.com/startup-battlefield/)

TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 is legendary for its Startup Battlefield pitch competition. Pricing is TBD, with a waitlist for early rates.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - TechCrunch Disrupt 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4d9_1760340894015-https___techcrunch_com_startup_battlefield_.jpeg)

- **Features:** 200 startups compete, $100,000 equity-free prize, masterclasses.
- **Benefits:** Media coverage, access to VCs, training resources.
- **Target Audience:** Early-stage startups in AI, robotics, healthtech, fintech.
- **Pros:** Prestigious platform, high visibility, strong alumni network.
- **Cons:** Highly selective, requires top-tier pitch preparation.

Joining this pitch competition puts your company in front of the world’s leading tech investors.

### [Web Summit PITCH Lisbon 2025](https://websummit.com/)

Web Summit’s PITCH Lisbon 2025 is a key pitch competition for early-stage startups. Tickets cost €950, including a bonus ticket for pre-registrants.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Web Summit PITCH Lisbon 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4df_1760340900677-https___websummit_com_.jpeg)

- **Features:** PITCH competition, 2,500+ journalists, global leaders.
- **Benefits:** Major media attention, networking, access to tech giants.
- **Target Audience:** Early-stage tech companies, founders seeking European exposure.
- **Pros:** Unmatched exposure, top CEO networking.
- **Cons:** No monetary prize, fierce competition.

For startups wanting visibility and connections in Europe, this pitch competition offers a golden gateway.

### [South Summit Startup Competition 2025](https://www.southsummit.co/)

South Summit 2025 spans Madrid and Porto Alegre, making it a unique dual-location pitch competition. Pricing ranges from €329–€1,050; pitching is free to apply.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - South Summit Startup Competition 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4d1_1760340909055-https___www_southsummit_co_.jpeg)

- **Features:** Open to all sectors, top 100 innovative startups.
- **Benefits:** Investment opportunities, mentoring, international exposure.
- **Target Audience:** Startups at any stage, especially for Spanish and Latin American markets.
- **Pros:** Dual-location access, strong investor presence.
- **Cons:** Application deadlines vary, travel logistics.

This pitch competition is perfect for startups aiming to break into Spanish-speaking ecosystems.

### [Y Combinator Demo Day 2025](https://www.ycombinator.com/demoday/)

Y Combinator Demo Day 2025 is the capstone of YC’s 11-week accelerator and a top-tier pitch competition. There’s no cost to participate, but YC funding requires equity.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Y Combinator Demo Day 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4cb_1760340916591-https___www_ycombinator_com_demoday_.jpeg)

- **Features:** $500,000 investment per startup, invite-only Demo Day.
- **Benefits:** Elite investor access, mentorship, powerful alumni network.
- **Target Audience:** Scalable startups, global founders.
- **Pros:** High funding, proven track record, global reach.
- **Cons:** Highly competitive, relocation required.

This pitch competition is renowned for launching unicorns and accelerating growth.

### [Web Summit Vancouver 2025](https://vancouver.websummit.com/)

Web Summit Vancouver 2025 debuts as a North American extension of the famous pitch competition series. Pricing ranges from C$415–C$7,870; ALPHA program includes three tickets for selected startups.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Web Summit Vancouver 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4e8_1760340923592-https___vancouver_websummit_com_.jpeg)

- **Features:** ALPHA program, investor matchmaking, PITCH battle.
- **Benefits:** North American market access, mentorship, global exposure.
- **Target Audience:** Early-stage startups seeking international reach.
- **Pros:** Strong mentorship, diverse industry focus.
- **Cons:** No direct cash prize, travel expenses.

Startups looking for North American expansion should consider this pitch competition for its networking and exposure.

### [Utah Entrepreneur Challenge 2025](https://lassonde.utah.edu/uec/)

Utah Entrepreneur Challenge 2025 is a statewide pitch competition for Utah university students. Participation is free.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Utah Entrepreneur Challenge 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4dc_1760340931919-https___lassonde_utah_edu_uec_.jpeg)

- **Features:** $100,000 in cash/prizes, coaching, feedback.
- **Benefits:** Funding, mentorship, local media coverage.
- **Target Audience:** University students in Utah with startup ambitions.
- **Pros:** No entry fee, strong support.
- **Cons:** Geographic and eligibility restrictions.

This pitch competition is a launchpad for student founders in Utah.

### [Next Founders 2025](https://www.nextcanada.com/next-founders/)

Next Founders 2025 is a free Toronto-based pitch competition focused on founder growth.

![Top 10 Pitch Competition Events to Watch in 2025 - Next Founders 2025](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66efccf0a803cdb85497b2a7/68ecacf4955088aa2880a4ce_1760340939108-https___www_nextcanada_com_next_founders_.jpeg)

- **Features:** Mentorship, workshops, Venture Day pitch event.
- **Benefits:** Skill development, investor access, peer learning.
- **Target Audience:** Canadian founders with a launched product.
- **Pros:** No cost, extensive mentorship, strong local network.
- **Cons:** Canada-focused, requires traction.

Canadian startups with market-ready products should explore this pitch competition for growth and networking.

### [Young Entrepreneur Summit 2025](https://www.youngentrepreneursummit.com/)

Young Entrepreneur Summit 2025 is a dedicated pitch competition for young founders. Pricing is TBA.

- **Features:** Summit, pitch competition, networking, workshops.
- **Benefits:** Youth-focused mentorship, exposure, prize opportunities.
- **Target Audience:** Young entrepreneurs, student founders.
- **Pros:** Tailored for youth, supportive ecosystem.
- **Cons:** Age restrictions, prize details vary.

This pitch competition empowers the next generation of innovators through guidance and exposure.

* * *

The pitch competition landscape in 2025 is more diverse, accessible, and rewarding than ever. Whether you’re seeking funding, mentorship, or global exposure, these events offer unique opportunities to showcase your startup, connect with investors, and accelerate your business journey.

## How to Choose the Right Pitch Competition for Your Startup

Choosing the best pitch competition for your startup can feel like navigating a maze. The stakes are high and the right decision can open doors to funding, mentorship, and fresh opportunities. Here’s how you can make a strategic choice that aligns with your goals and maximizes your startup’s growth.

### Step 1: Assess Your Startup’s Stage and Sector

Begin by pinpointing your startup’s current stage and industry focus. Are you pre-revenue, or do you have traction in healthtech, fintech, or sustainability? Some pitch competition events cater to early-stage ideas, while others target scaling ventures or specific sectors.

Matching your business profile to the right pitch competition ensures you’ll face relevant judges and connect with investors who understand your market. Research each event’s target audience and past participants to see where your startup fits best.

### Step 2: Evaluate Competition Offerings

Not all competitions offer the same value. Look beyond headline prizes to understand what’s on the table: Is there direct investment, mentorship, or media exposure? Some pitch competition events provide access to exclusive networks, while others focus on hands-on training.

Consider reading about the [Impact of Pitch Competitions on Startup Valuation](https://fastercapital.com/articles/The-Impact-of-Pitch-Competitions-on-Startup-Valuation.html) to see how different event features can boost your business’s appeal to investors. Weigh these offerings carefully, as some may align better with your funding needs or long-term vision.

### Step 3: Consider Logistics and ROI

Factor in practicalities: Is the pitch competition in-person, hybrid, or fully virtual? Virtual and hybrid events can reduce travel costs and widen your reach, making participation more accessible.

Examine the entry fees, preparation requirements, and potential ROI. High-profile competitions often demand more time and resources but can deliver outsized exposure. Balance the investment of money and effort against the visibility and connections you stand to gain.

### Step 4: Research and Leverage Community

Dig into each competition’s history. Who are the past winners, and what have they achieved since? Alumni testimonials and event recaps can offer honest insights into the real impact of participating.

Tap into alumni networks and seek out founder feedback. These communities can provide guidance on application tips, pitch preparation, and what to expect from the event experience.

### Example: Finding Your Perfect Match

For instance, a healthtech startup might prioritize a pitch competition like TechCrunch Disrupt or the Startup World Cup, where sector expertise, major funding, and strong investor networks are front and center.

By following these steps, you’ll increase your odds of choosing a pitch competition that not only matches your ambitions but also delivers lasting benefits for your startup’s journey.

## Maximizing Your Pitch Competition Experience in 2025

Ready to make the most of your next pitch competition? Standing out in 2025 means more than just having a great idea. With the right approach, founders can turn every pitch competition into a strategic launchpad for growth and investment.

### Pitch Preparation

Success starts before you ever step on stage. Tailor your pitch deck specifically for each pitch competition, focusing on clarity and impact.

Consider these essential steps:

- Research each event’s format and judging criteria.
- Highlight your unique value proposition and traction.
- Practice your delivery with mentors or peers to refine your message.

Attend preparatory workshops where possible to boost your confidence and sharpen your pitch. A compelling story and clear business model make all the difference.

### Networking & Engagement

The real magic of a pitch competition often happens offstage. Proactively connect with judges, investors, and fellow founders before, during, and after the event.

Here’s how to maximize your network:

- Join event meetups and breakout sessions.
- Exchange contact information with key players.
- Ask for feedback and insights on your pitch.

Strong networking pays off—startups that actively engage at pitch events raise 30% more funding on average (GrowthMentor.com). For more tips, check out [Startup meetups and networking events](https://swisspreneur.org/blog/startup-meetups).

### Post-Event Strategies & Leveraging Exposure

Your pitch competition journey does not end when the spotlight fades. Use judge and peer feedback to refine your business model and update your pitch materials.

Leverage the exposure you gain for media coverage, new partnerships, and customer growth. Follow up promptly with investors and contacts you met at the event—many successful startups, like those from Slush and YC Demo Day, secure additional funding through diligent post-event networking.

A pitch competition can be the spark that lights your startup’s next big opportunity.

## Trends Shaping Pitch Competitions in 2025

The landscape of pitch competition events is evolving rapidly in 2025, opening doors for founders across the globe. Startups are finding more ways to participate, connect, and stand out as the pitch competition scene adapts to new technologies and shifting priorities. If you want to stay ahead, keeping up with these trends is essential.

### Hybrid, Virtual, and Tech-Driven Engagement

Hybrid and virtual formats are now the norm, making pitch competition events more accessible than ever before. In 2024, 40% more startups joined virtual or hybrid competitions compared to 2022. This shift lets founders from any region participate without travel barriers, expanding the diversity of ideas on stage.

AI and data analytics are transforming how startups are evaluated. Judging is becoming more objective, with instant feedback and tailored scoring. Organizers now use live streaming, audience voting, and interactive platforms to boost engagement, making every pitch competition a truly global event.

For deeper insights into how these advances are reshaping startup funding opportunities, check out this article on the [role of pitch competitions in startup funding strategies](https://growett.com/blogs/The-role-of-pitch-competitions-in-startup-funding-strategies.html).

### Inclusion, Specialization, and Post-Event Support

Diversity, equity, and inclusion are taking center stage in pitch competition selection and judging. More events are prioritizing underrepresented founders and ensuring fair evaluation. This trend is helping to foster a richer, more innovative startup ecosystem.

Sector-specific competitions are on the rise, with dedicated events for fintech, healthtech, and sustainability. These specialized pitch competition formats connect founders with targeted mentors and investors, increasing the odds of meaningful partnerships.

Organizers are also offering stronger post-event support, from mentorship programs to global networking opportunities. Building a solid startup community is now as important as the competition itself, as highlighted in this guide on [building a startup community first](https://swisspreneur.org/blog/building-a-startup-community-first).

Looking ahead, the pitch competition landscape will keep evolving to meet the needs of ambitious founders. Whether you seek funding, feedback, or global exposure, these trends ensure there is a pitch competition perfectly suited for your next big leap.

After exploring the most exciting pitch competitions coming up in 2025, you might be thinking about how you can get even closer to Switzerland’s thriving startup scene. If you’re a founder looking for hands-on support, insights from top entrepreneurs, and a real sense of community, I highly recommend you [apply to our swiss founders community](https://swisspreneur.typeform.com/to/sTWnkKVo?typeform-source=www.swisspreneur.org). Pitching competitions are to startup entrepreneurs what skydiving is to most people: a bucket-list item that’s both exciting and terrifying. To take the skydiving analogy further, joining a Startup Pitch Competition may be the only way for your business to land where it’s supposed to.

During such an event, you get to pitch to multiple investors, gain some valuable exposure, and get some equally valuable feedback. You will network, you will potentially build partnerships, but, most importantly, you will get a chance to [secure funding](https://www.growthmentor.com/expertise/startup-funding-experts/) and accelerate your business. All you need to do is jump from the airplane… but which one?

To take the guesswork out of the process, we’ve compiled below a list of the best Startup Pitch Competitions you can attend this year. Do your research to decide which one (or ones) is the best fit for you and your startup idea/business. Check the qualifications for entry and [prepare your best pitch deck yet](https://www.growthmentor.com/blog/pitch-deck-review/) — make sure to steer clear of too much text or super busy visuals/animations.

And when it’s time to stand in front of the judges, contrary to skydiving, remember that you should open your “parachute” right away. Usually, you’ll have only a few minutes to wow your audience, so don’t wait: Cut straight to the chase, using language that’s simple but captivating. Show them you are your brand’s biggest fan… and they will probably become its fans too. See you on the stage!

### Does pitching your idea make you nervous?

This could be the single most important moment of your life and determine your entire future – no pressure though!

Hopping on 1:1 calls with vetted startup mentors who have already raised millions of dollars themselves is an excellent way to prepare for your startup pitch.

**Suggested Mentors for Pitch Prep:**

- [**Manish Balakrishnan:** Pitched to raise pre-seed and seed funding of $1.3mn at various startups](https://app.growthmentor.com/mentors/manish-balakrishnan)

# The 2025 AI Pitch Competition witnessed the power of AI for Good

FABBS, ZZZ\*, EviSafe, UTF, ArtVista, Avendar, Vendacity, and DataSpeak: eight startups working on solving today's pressing issues.

Published on November 17, 2025

![Fabbs winning the grand prize of 50,000 euros](https://ioplus.nl/_next/image?url=%2Fapi%2Fmedia%2Ffile%2FAI%2520Pitch%2520Competition-03427.jpg%2520Fabbs&w=2048&q=75)

[![Bart Brouwers](https://ioplus.nl/_next/image?url=%2Fapi%2Fmedia%2Ffile%2FBB2.png&w=2048&q=75)](https://ioplus.nl/en/authors/bart)[**By: BartBrouwers**](https://ioplus.nl/en/authors/bart)

Bart, co-founder of Media52 and Professor of Journalism oversees IO+, events, and Laio. A journalist at heart, he keeps writing as many stories as possible.

[Share on BlueSky](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=Check%20out%20this%20article:%20https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/the-2025-ai-pitch-competition-witnessed-the-power-of-ai-for-good)[Share on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/the-2025-ai-pitch-competition-witnessed-the-power-of-ai-for-good)[Share on Mastodon](https://mastodon.social/share?text=Check%20out%20this%20article:%20https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/the-2025-ai-pitch-competition-witnessed-the-power-of-ai-for-good)[Share on Threads](https://www.threads.net/intent/post?text=Check%20out%20this%20article:%20https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/the-2025-ai-pitch-competition-witnessed-the-power-of-ai-for-good)[Share on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/?text=Check%20out%20this%20article:%20https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/the-2025-ai-pitch-competition-witnessed-the-power-of-ai-for-good)

FABBS, ZZZ\* EviSafe, UTF, ArtVista, Avendar, Vendacity, and DataSpeak... This year's [AI Pitch Competition](https://aipitchcompetition.com/) spotlighted some of the most innovative AI solutions and offered eight startups an opportunity to present their ideas, connect with industry leaders, and accelerate their growth. With team FABBS - already the winners of Gerard & Anton Golden Light Bulb last summer - as the winners.

In the months leading up to the finale, the participants took part in an inspiring program, from the introductions in September to the _How to Pitch_ Workshop in October, refining their concepts and presentation skills. The competition, sponsored by the province of Noord-Brabant, highlighted AI-driven entrepreneurship, innovation, and collaboration.

This event was organized by Braventure, Erasmus Enterprise, and IO+.

## Eight startups, eight prizes

1st prize: €50,000: [**FABBS**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/fabbs-offers-batteries-an-energetic-second-life), extending battery life with AI-driven cell-level monitoring to enable more sustainable energy storage.

FABBS pitching

2nd prize: €35,000: [**Team**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/medai-clarity-for-relatives-and-doctors-in-the-toughest-times-) **ZZZ\***, using AI to analyse EEG data and help doctors predict recovery outcomes for coma patients.

ZZZ\*pitching

3rd prize: €25,000: [**EviSafe**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/evisafe-is-not-just-building-ai-but-also-trust-safety-and-hope), empowering victims of abuse with an AI app for discreet evidence collection and emergency alerts.

EviSafe pitching

Audience award: €10,000: [**UTF**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/co-creation-with-civil-servants-is-crucial-for-utfai), automating and optimising public-sector workflows with AI to improve efficiency and transparency.

UTF pitching

5th prize: Business Development by Startups for Society was offered to [**ArtVista**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/this-is-how-artvista-amplifies-the-soul-of-art), an AI-powered app that personalises museum visits and connects visitors with artists.

ArtVista pitching

6th prize: Production & distribution of your next press release by IO+ was offered to [**Avendar**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/avendar-helps-the-police-catch-criminals-with-data), which develops AI solutions to enhance real-time decision-making in security and defence.

Avendar pitching

Nr. 7: 1 hour Investment Coaching by Erasmus Enterprise was given to [**Vendacity**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/vendacity-empowering-investment-professionals-with-relevant-data), providing smart analytics for startups to automate reporting and track key performance data.

Vendacity pitching

Nr. 8: 2 tickets to MT/Sprout Community Event & €250 worth of merchandise by Braventure rewarded to [**DataSpeak**](https://ioplus.nl/en/posts/dataspeak-the-bridge-that-connects-ai-to-real-business-processes), creating enterprise-grade conversational AI that performs tasks securely within EU data standards.

DataSpeak pitching

- _ZZZ\* is in the process of finding a permanent name._

Snowflake and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) join forces once again to ignite innovation and empower Al startups around the world with the Snowflake Startup Challenge! The Snowflake Startup Challenge is a contest for early-stage startups that are building innovative applications and products powered by Snowflake’s Al Data Cloud.

- Be an entity that has not received any cash funding through the sale of equity securities of the Startup that surpasses a Series A or later funding round

## Participate in Pitch Contest to Gain Media Attention and International Connections

## How to Register for InnoVEX 2026 Pitch Contest

### Eligibility

- The participating startups must be founded after January 1st, 2018, or be academic or research-based teams planning to establish a company.
- Participating teams are required to pay the base registration fee of NT$40,000 (exclusive of tax) for Taiwanese teams, or USD 1,350 for overseas teams, via bank transfer (wire transfer) only.
- InnoVEX 2026 exhibitors are exempt from the registration fee.
- Finalists must attend the final demo pitch in person in Taiwan on June 4, 2026. Failure to attend will result in forfeiture of eligibility, and no registration fee refund will be issued.

### How to Register

- **The deadline is May 5th 23:59 (GMT+8).**
- Online registration only. After logging into My InnoVEX, click on the APPLY FOR PITCH CONTEST button on the front page to register.
- Registration is considered complete only after clicking "SUBMIT" to submit the registration form by the deadline. In addition, non-exhibitors should upload the payment certificate before the registration deadline to qualify for participation.

# The Best Entrepreneur Competitions To Pitch Your Startup Idea

Pitching competitions can be a great way to open the door to the investment world and make connections that can aid your business endeavors far into the future.

Key Takeaways

1. Entrepreneurs can gain exposure and potential funding by presenting their business ideas in pitch competitions.
2. Pitch competitions provide valuable opportunities to make connections with investors, judges, and fellow entrepreneurs.
3. Be concise, know your audience, and be prepared to answer questions to improve your chances of winning a pitch competition.

Starting a business often means getting creative with funding. For many startups, traditional financing isn’t an option early on, which pushes founders to look for alternative ways to raise capital and gain exposure.

One popular option is entrepreneurship pitch competitions, where startups present their ideas for a chance to win funding, mentorship, or other resources.

## What Is A Pitch Competition?

A pitch competition is a contest where entrepreneurs present their business concept to a panel in the hope of winning a cash prize or investment capital.

Pitch competitions all have specific parameters and rules, but no matter what, business owners will be up against any number of other entrepreneurs with their own business ideas. Even if you don’t win, the pitch competition can be a way to introduce yourself to the elite world of venture capital and angel investment.

## Best Pitching Competitions To Enter

Business pitch competitions happen frequently throughout the year, with most taking place annually. Here are some popular options to get you started.

### AATCC Concept 2 Consumer Student Design Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** Be an undergraduate or graduate; be a member of AATCC
- **Website:** [https://www.aatcc.org/aatcc-grants/grants/](https://www.aatcc.org/aatcc-grants/grants/)

This grant is available to graduate and undergrad students for textile-related research projects.

### Arch Grants Global Startup Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** Must be a for-profit startup with a plan to scale to national or international impact
- **Website:** [https://www.aatcc.org/aatcc-grants/grants/](https://www.aatcc.org/aatcc-grants/grants/)

This equity-free $75,000 grant competition is open to startups from around the world. Winners must relocate their headquarters to St. Louis for at least one year (additional funding is provided for relocation).

### Baylor New Venture Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** Be an undergraduate, graduate, or recently graduated alumnus from an accredited not-for-profit university
- **Website:** [https://www.baylor.edu/business/newventurecompetition/index.php?id=93663](https://www.baylor.edu/business/newventurecompetition/index.php?id=93663)

Student entrepreneurs from across the globe are offered expert feedback, coaching, and a prize package of cash and crucial in-kind business support services to launch and grow their ventures.

### Cartier Women’s Initiative Awards

- **Entry Requirements:** The business is generating revenue but has raised less than $2 million, one to six years in registered operation, and must be woman-owned
- **Website:** [https://www.cartierwomensinitiative.com/regional-awards](https://www.cartierwomensinitiative.com/regional-awards)

This is a worldwide competition for women entrepreneurs who have been in business for over a year. Competition is broken down into nine regions. The grand prize is a $100,000 grant for the winner from each region.

### Citizen Entrepreneurship Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** Age brackets separate youth and adult (30+) competitions
- **Website:** [https://www.entrepreneurship-campus.org/about-the-competitions/](https://www.entrepreneurship-campus.org/about-the-competitions/)

This is an international competition for businesses pitching ideas that target social, environmental, health, and governmental challenges.

### CodeLaunch

- **Entry Requirements:** The startup must be dependent on software development expertise
- **Website:** [https://www.codelaunch.com/](https://www.codelaunch.com/)

CodeLaunch provides seed services to early-stage startups. Several events are held throughout the year in different locations.

### TechCrunch Disrupt

- **Entry Requirements:** Early-stage startup; must have some tech component to the business idea
- **Website:** [https://techcrunch.com/events/](https://techcrunch.com/events/)

TechCrunch Disrupt brings together investors, entrepreneurs, and developers from around the world.

### Founders Live NYC

- **Entry Requirements:** Join the Founders Live group
- **Website:** [https://www.founderslive.com/](https://www.founderslive.com/)

Multiple events are held featuring five founders giving 99-second pitches, and viewers pick the winner. The organization is active in 120 cities across 46 countries.

### Hello Tomorrow Global Summit

- **Entry Requirements:** Must be in early stages (up to Series A), not a subsidiary or spin-off of an existing company, must be a team of 2+ people, and must address an industrial, societal, or environmental unmet need or create a new market
- **Website:** [https://hello-tomorrow.org/summit/](https://hello-tomorrow.org/summit/)

This is a worldwide competition, with startup categories in energy, agriculture, healthcare, AI, new materials, and more.

### Milken-Penn GSE Education Business Plan Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** Your business idea must be education-oriented
- **Website:** [https://www.educationcompetition.org/](https://www.educationcompetition.org/)

This is a competition dedicated to addressing problems and trends within education around the world.

### New Venture Championship

- **Entry Requirements:** Must be a graduate or undergraduate
- **Website:** [https://business.uoregon.edu/nvc/](https://business.uoregon.edu/nvc/)

This is an annual, six-round competition for students from around the world.

### Rice Business Plan Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** The project is student-created or managed and has not raised more than $250,000 in equity, or generated more than $100,000 in a 12-month period prior to the application
- **Website:** [https://rbpc.rice.edu/](https://rbpc.rice.edu/)

This is Rice University’s internationally-recognized graduate entrepreneurship competition.

### TCU Neeley School Of Business Values & Venture Competition

- **Entry Requirements:** Undergraduates only; no nonprofits
- **Website:** [https://neeley.tcu.edu//vandv/](https://neeley.tcu.edu//vandv/)

TCU’s undergraduate contest is open to undergrads with business ideas that contribute to innovations in health, life, or energy.

### FTxSDG Seedstars Challenge

- **Entry Requirements:** Received less than $500,000 in funding to date and must be scalable
- **Website:** [https://www.seedstarsworld.com/ft-x-seedstars-challenge/](https://www.seedstarsworld.com/ft-x-seedstars-challenge/)

This a worldwide contest that recognizes winners in areas including climate action, gender equality, reduced inequalities, and quality education.

### SPIE Startup Challenge

- **Entry Requirements:** Must have an optics or photonics technology or application
- **Website:** [https://spie.org/industry-resources/industry-events/spie-startup-challenge](https://spie.org/industry-resources/industry-events/spie-startup-challenge?SSO=1)

This contest focuses on healthcare and deep tech. Applicants choose from one of two tracks based on their development stage. A cash prize of $10,000 is presented to the first place winner.

### SXSW Pitch

- **Entry Requirements:** The product must be recent (see guidelines) and have raised no more than $10 million in funding; each company may enter no more than one product
- **Website:** [https://www.sxsw.com/awards/sxsw-pitch/](https://www.sxsw.com/awards/sxsw-pitch/)

This contest includes nine different categories. Some of those categories open to the pitch competition include AgTech, HealthTech, and Security.

### Y Combinator Demo Day

- **Entry Requirements:** Invitation only; invitations are software-generated and based on recent investments in YC startups
- **Website:** [https://www.ycombinator.com/demoday/](https://www.ycombinator.com/demoday/)

Y Combinator is one of the premier startup incubators. Companies that have made it through the program can apply to demo their business concept on Demo Day, which occurs twice a year over the course of three days. The third day, called Investor Day, lets entrepreneurs sit down with investors and pitch their ideas.

## How To Improve Your Chances Of Winning A Pitch Competition

Pitch competitions can be valuable even if you don’t win, but the goal is still to stand out and make an impression. Here are a few ways to strengthen your pitch and improve your odds.

### Be Concise

Judges see a lot of pitches in a short amount of time. Keep yours clear and focused. Your core idea should be easy to understand, even for someone outside your industry.

Strip your pitch down to what matters most and leave out unnecessary detail.

### Know Your Audience

Industry jargon can work against you. Adjust your language based on who’s listening, and prioritize clarity over sounding technical.

A strong pitch should make sense to anyone in the room.

### Build Connections

Pitch competitions aren’t just about winning. Building rapport with judges, other founders, and attendees can influence how your idea is received and open doors after the event.

### Apply Early

Applying early gives you time to catch mistakes, refine your pitch, and avoid last-minute stress. A polished application almost always beats a rushed one.

### Be Ready To Answer Questions

Expect follow-up questions and plan simple, confident answers. Knowing how to explain your business under pressure can make a big difference.

### Be Memorable

Many competitors follow the same advice and deliver similar pitches. If your personality, story, or presentation style sets you apart, lean into it (as long as it supports your message).

## Pitch Your Way To A Successful Startup

Pitching and startup competitions can be a great way to get your foot into the door to the investment world. You’ll have a captive audience and the opportunity to make connections that can aid your business endeavors far into the future.

Other ways to get money to fund your startup is through small business grants. As with pitch competitions, competition is pretty fierce, but it doesn’t hurt to apply for grants (provided you meet the requirements).
